cases.case_label: Exonic LINE-1 insertion in CC2D2A in trans with a missense variant in Joubert syndrome
cases.mechanism_detail: Long-read whole-genome sequencing with haplotype phasing showed two affected Japanese siblings carried an exonic LINE-1 insertion in CC2D2A in trans with the missense variant c.4454A>G p.(Tyr1485Cys); biallelism was established without parental samples. Rare carriers of the same exonic LINE-1 were found in in-house genomes.
cases.quote: The affected siblings had a novel nonsynonymous variant (CC2D2A:NM_001080522.2:c.4454A>G:p.(Tyr1485Cys)) and an exonic insertion of Long INterspercsed Element-1 (LINE-1).
